lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Regularly spaced 2D lattice of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in approximately 10-12 vertical columns and 6-8 horizontal rows posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to form a defined grid-like coordinate system across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features running across the upper and mid-flank, defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs contained within the visible silhouette of the dorsal fin, concentrated primarily along the posterior margin.
